title: SIDESTORY: RETRACING OUR STEPS OPEN
lines: 01 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SIDESTORY: RETRACING OUR STEPS OPEN

DETAILS: Retracing Our Steps event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, Karlan Trade R&D, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
Phase 1
Open Stages: [Pilgrimage through Blizzards]
Phase 2
Open Stages: [Road of Reformation]
Phase 3
Open Stages: [Heart of Karlan]
[Karlan Trade R&D ]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [rebuilding regions] by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: Emergency Rescue Kit (provides random materials), Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, and more.
[Oracular Riddles]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Oracular Riddles] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★★: Astgenne the Lightchaser], Karlan Trade Lounge (Pieces), Module Materials, Multi-functional Snow Detector, etc.
[Observatory Support Division]
DETAILS: During the event, you can collect [Multi-functional Snow Detector] by participating in the event and use them to redeem items for rewards.

REWARDS: Astgenne the Lightchaser's Token, Karlan Trade Lounge (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Icefield Messenger Series - Cheerful Guardian for Cardigan, 0011 Productions Series - Clivia for Jessica, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, and more.
NOTE:
- Please refer to the official introduction for more details.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – A SHARED OATH OF GUARDIANSHIP
DURATION: April 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7) - April 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [A Shared Oath of Guardianship], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: SilverAsh the Reignfrost [Limited] / Pramanix the Prerita
★★★★★★: Lappland the Decadenza [Limited] / Wiš'adel [Limited] / Virtuosa [Limited]
★★★★★: Snow Hunter

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator SilverAsh the Reignfrost after a total of 300 rolls (once only). This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get the next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
NOTE:
- [A Shared Oath of Guardianship] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
- Pramanix the Prerita and Snow Hunter will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after April 28, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- Operator Nearl the Radiant Knight will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Celebration]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for Nearl the Radiant Knight will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:
★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contract): SilverAsh the Reignfrost \ Pramanix the Prerita \ Lappland the Decadenza \ Wiš'adel \ Virtuosa \ Muelsyse \ Texas the Omertosa \ Specter the Unchained
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contract): Nearl the Radiant Knight / Skadi the Corrupting Heart / Rosmontis / W
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contract): Snow Hunter
- Operator SilverAsh the Reignfrost is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: April 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7) - April 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Log in during the event to claim rewards on event page: Traces of Melted Snow Headhunting Permit * 1
NOTE:
- Traces of Melted Snow Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [A Shared Oath of Guardianship] Limited Headhunting.
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
- Traces of Melted Snow Headhunting Permit expires at: April 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] DAILY FREE ROLL IN [ A SHARED OATH OF GUARDIANSHIP ] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DURATION: April 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7) - April 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [A Shared Oath of Guardianship] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE:
- Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SPECIAL RECRUITMENT OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, Job Tags that include the corresponding tags are guaranteed when refreshing. Top Operator tag is guaranteed to appear during the event (once only). By completing the Special Recruitment with the Top Operator tag in this period, you can obtain one 6★ Operator (limited to Operators available from Recruit).
Note:
- When the Top Operator tag is chosen and the Recruit time is set to 9 hours, a 6-star Operator is guaranteed.
06 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] LIMITED SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN

DURATION: April 14, 2026, 08:00 - April 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7) DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Exclusive Outfit for Estelle, Exclusive Furniture - 'Statue in Storm', Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Orundum, Elite Materials, and more.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Skill Summary - 1 * 30, Exclusive Furniture - 'Statue in Storm'
Day 4: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, LMD * 30000
Day 5: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 6: Pure Gold * 20, EPOQUE Collection - La Valse Couronnée de Fleurs for Estelle
Day 7: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
Day 8: Chip Catalyst * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 9: Module Data Block * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Day 10: Orundum * 200, Tactical Battle Record * 20
NOTE:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
07 2 026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] MOUNT KARLAN WISHING WALL OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Wishing Tickets after daily login. Consume trials to participate in [Mount Karlan Wishing Wall]. The Wishing Tickets with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Wishing Tickets.
- Players will randomly obtain the following amount of Orundum from Wishing Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.

DETAILS:

- After the [A Shared Oath of Guardianship] banner ends, [Pramanix the Prerita] and [Snow Hunter] will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after April 28, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Operator Hadiya and Akkord can be redeemed at the Purchase Certificates Store, and are NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.

- Operator SilverAsh the Reignfrost, Pramanix the Prerita, Astgenne the Lightchaser, and Snow Hunter will gain more trust in the event stages during April 14, 2026, 08:00 - May 5, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7).

13 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] OPTIMIZATION TO SANITY POTION USAGE
UPDATE TIME: April 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, all types of Sanity Potions will be used automatically upon expiry (The Sanity gained from using potions cannot exceed the upper limit of 999).
14 2026 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] OPTIMIZATIONS TO CLUES & SUPPORT FUNCTIONS
UPDATE TIME: May 21, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS:

- After the Clues Feature update, the Reception Room will add [Quick Place] and [Quickly give duplicate clues] functions. Quick Place allows you to conveniently place owned clues into the corresponding slots, prioritizing those closest to expiration; [Quickly give duplicate clues] allows you to send duplicate clues you hold to friends who are missing the corresponding clues in one go.

- After the Support Function improvements, players can borrow Support Operators according to their original proficiencies level (including level, Modules, and Specialize skill), no longer affected by the highest-level Operator in the squad or whether the player is on the friend list.
